description:
NASA-IR benchmark
	

NASA SMD and IBM Research developed a domain-specific information retrieval benchmark, NASA-IR, spanning almost 500 question-answer pairs related to the Earth science, planetary science, heliophysics, astrophysics, and biological physical sciences domains. Specifically, we sampled a set of 166 paragraphs from AGU, AMS, ADS, PMC, and PubMed and manually annotated with 3 questions that are answerable from each of these paragraphs, resulting in 498 questions. reputation: An academic, domain-specific information retrieval benchmark used in research on retrieval for Earth and space science literature; primarily of interest to IR researchers.
